info.name: StyleMind Stylist — P03-B1 Request Intake
info.description: Stores owner-scoped styling requests as RECEIVED. No generation, owned context, provider or LLM is invoked. Requires the existing Gateway and a Stylist runtime backed by a disposable database with V1 and V2 applied.

item.name: 1. Create a session as Customer A

exec: pm.test('session id stored', function () { var body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.session_id).to.be.a('string'); pm.environment.set('sessionId', body.session_id); });

item.name: 2. Submit a request as Customer A (no generation)

exec: pm.test('request stored only', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); var body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.request_status).to.eql('RECEIVED'); pm.expect(body.generation_started).to.eql(false); pm.environment.set('requestId', body.request_id); pm.environment.set('sourceMessageId', body.source_message_id); });

item.name: 3. Reference the USER message without copying it

exec: pm.test('existing USER message is referenced', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); var body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.source_message_id).to.eql(pm.environment.get('sourceMessageId')); pm.expect(body.request_status).to.eql('RECEIVED'); pm.expect(body.generation_started).to.eql(false); });

pm.test('request belongs to A and remains RECEIVED', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); var body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.request_id).to.eql(pm.environment.get('requestId')); pm.expect(body.request_status).to.eql('RECEIVED'); pm.expect(body.generation_started).to.eql(false); pm.expect(body.constraints).to.have.length(1); });

item.name: 5. Customer B cannot read Customer A's request

exec: pm.test('foreign request is concealed as not found', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(404); pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND'); });

item.name: 6. Admin cannot read Customer A's request
7. Reject GET body on encoded request route

exec: pm.test('encoded MVC route uses the GET body policy', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('INVALID_REQUEST'); });
pm.test('Unicode blank message is rejected', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('INVALID_REQUEST'); });

item.name: 9. Reject NUL in weather context safely

exec: pm.test('NUL is rejected as invalid input, not a server failure', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('INVALID_REQUEST'); });
